newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: DDB Needham opens Rapp Collins unit in NZ.
newsitem.headline: DDB Needham opens Rapp Collins unit in NZ.

text.p: Direct marketing agency Rapp Collins, part of the Omnicom Group of the U.S., said it had opened a presence in New Zealand within the offices of group stablemate, advertising agency DDB Needham New Zealand.

In a statement DDB chief executive Douglas Faudet said, "It is time for Rapp Collins. We have spent two years developing our direct marketing expertise within DDB planning the introduction of an operation such as this."
Like Rapp Collins operations worldwide the New Zealand unit "will have a high degree of autonomy", he added.
The office will be opened in Auckland on July 1.
